decks.notes: The key concept of this deck is to utilize artifacts, specifically blue artifacts, to quickly ramp up and overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. By using cards like Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Urza's Saga, along with Mox Opal and Mishra's Bauble, the deck aims to generate a strong board presence early on and maintain control with cards like Force of Will. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Chalice of the Void and Otawara, Soaring City adds disruption and protection to the deck's strategy, allowing for a fast and efficient win condition.

The deck revolves around quickly assembling the Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage combo to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token, often through the use of cards like Crop Rotation and Green Sun's Zenith to search for key pieces. It also includes backup plans with Knight of the Reliquary and Elvish Reclaimer to efficiently search for lands and disruption cards like Swords to Plowshares to control the board. The deck aims to win through a powerful combo while also maintaining a solid control and disruptive game plan against opponents.

The main focus of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's plays while quickly applying pressure with aggressive creatures and burn spells. By playing powerful nonbasic land hate cards like Blood Moon and Chalice of the Void, the deck aims to shut down the opponent's mana base while utilizing fast mana acceleration from cards like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide. Once the opponent is locked out of the game, the deck looks to close out the game with efficient aggressive creatures like Goblin Rabblemaster and finish them off with burn spells like Shatterskull Smashing and Fury.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill your graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Grief, then bring them back onto the battlefield using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead to overwhelm your opponent with strong creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier. The deck also includes disruption and protection cards like Force of Will and Daze to help ensure your combos go off smoothly. With a mix of aggressive plays and control elements, this deck aims to win the game through powerful combos and reanimation strategies.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Dragon's Rage Channeler, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Force of Will and Wasteland. The deck aims to control the board with countermagic and removal spells like Lightning Bolt, while also generating card advantage through cards like Mishra's Bauble and Brainstorm. By utilizing cantrips like Ponder and efficient threats like Murktide Regent, the deck aims to pressure the opponent's life total while keeping their options limited.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Grief, in order to reanimate them with spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The key strategy is to cheat out big threats like Griselbrand and Archon of Cruelty early in the game to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Unmask to protect the combo. The inclusion of Wasteland helps to disrupt the opponent's mana base, while cards like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal allow for explosive plays. The deck aims to win quickly through a powerful reanimation strategy.

The deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Troll of Khazad-dûm and Archon of Cruelty, then bringing them back into play with cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The strategy revolves around using Entomb to get creatures into the graveyard, and protecting the combo with cards like Force of Will and Daze. By utilizing cards like Grief and Brainstorm, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while setting up its own game-winning plays. The inclusion of cards like Brazen Borrower and Atraxa, Grand Unifier adds versatility and additional threats to the deck.
